title: Show Tags Under Monitor Info
description:
*Description*
Currently, tag information is displayed at the bottom of the monitor Summary drawer. Move the Tags field into the *Monitor Info* section, directly after {*}Group{*}, so engineers and administrators can identify monitor tags without scrolling.
h3. Acceptance Criteria
 # Tags must be displayed under {*}Monitor Info{*}, after the *Group* field.
 # The standalone *Tag Info* section must be removed.
 # When one tag is available, display it as a tag chip.
 # When multiple tags are available, display the first tag and an additional count chip such as {{{}+5{}}}.
 # Hovering or clicking the count chip must display the complete tag list.
 # When no tag is assigned, display {{{}---{}}}.
 # Tag styling and interaction must align with the existing Group chip design.
 # Long tag values must not break or overflow the side drawer layout.

h3. Business Test Cases
||Scenario||Expected Result||
|An engineer opens a monitor with one tag|The tag is immediately visible under Monitor Info.|
|An administrator opens a monitor with multiple tags|The first tag and additional tag count are displayed.|
|A user selects or hovers over the additional tag count|The complete list of assigned tags is available.|
|A monitor has no assigned tags|The Tags field displays {{{}---{}}}.|
|A monitor contains long tag values|The drawer layout remains readable and aligned.|
|A user reviews CPU, memory, or disk information|No duplicate Tag Info section is shown at the bottom.|
